:::

## 10. Cell-level QC {#sec-cell-level-qc}

**After** tile + SNR (sections 7-9): when segmentation exists, you can sanity-check that **per-cell** optics line up with **tile-level** blur/focus calls—large disagreement can mean **boundary cells**, **registration**, or **segmentation** issues worth investigating before heavy single-cell work. This section is **microscopy-focused** per-cell QC, while section 9 is **count-matrix SNR** from **`cell_feature_matrix.h5`**. Shown when **`image_qc_metrics.json`** is present. **`CCFS_DAPI`** is the **per-cell** focus score (same **CCFS** construction as in **tile focus and blur**, averaged over each **cell/nucleus mask**). Figures **compare** that view to **tile-level** focus (e.g. tile at the cell centroid) for **agreement**, not as a duplicate primary gate in this tile-first report.

```{python cell-section}
#| echo: false

if cell_metrics is None:
    print("_No cell-level image QC metrics for this run (expected for bundle-only / no cells path)._")
else:
    display(Markdown("### Per-cell summary"))
    def _fmt_cell_value(v):
        if isinstance(v, (int, np.integer)):
            return f"{int(v):,}"
        if isinstance(v, (float, np.floating)) and np.isfinite(float(v)):
            return f"{float(v):,.3f}"
        return v
    # --- General cell metrics ---
    summary_keys = (
        "total_cells",
        "cells_with_transcripts",
        "mean_transcript_count",
        "median_transcript_count",
        "mean_ccfs_dapi",
        "median_ccfs_dapi",
        "cells_near_edge",
        "cells_near_holes",
        "cells_with_artifacts",
    )
    summary_rows = []
    for k in summary_keys:
        if k in cell_metrics:
            summary_rows.append(
                {
                    "Metric": k.replace("_", " "),
                    "Value": _fmt_cell_value(cell_metrics[k]),
                }
            )
    if "clusters_present" in cell_metrics:
        summary_rows.append(
            {
                "Metric": "clusters present",
                "Value": cell_metrics["clusters_present"],
            }
        )
    if summary_rows:
        _df_cell = pd.DataFrame(summary_rows)
        _sty_cell = (
            _df_cell.style
            .set_table_styles(
                [
                    {"selector": "th", "props": "text-align:left; background-color:#F8FAFC;"},
                    {"selector": "td", "props": "text-align:left; vertical-align:top;"},
                ]
            )
            .set_properties(subset=["Metric"], **{"min-width": "20em"})
            .set_properties(subset=["Value"], **{"min-width": "14em"})
            .hide(axis="index")
        )
        display(HTML(_sty_cell.to_html()))

    # --- Cell quality metrics: CCFS nuclear texture (absolute) vs GMM tile blur (relative) ---
    display(Markdown("### Cell quality: nuclear texture (CCFS) vs tile blur (GMM)"))

    _n = cell_metrics.get("total_cells", 0)
    _blur_rows = []
    if "cells_low_nuclear_texture" in cell_metrics:
        _thr = cell_metrics.get("ccfs_low_texture_threshold", "N/A")
        _pct = cell_metrics.get("pct_low_nuclear_texture")
        if _pct is None and _n > 0:
            _pct = round(100.0 * cell_metrics["cells_low_nuclear_texture"] / _n, 2)
        _blur_rows.append({
            "Method": "CCFS nuclear texture (absolute)",
            "Cells flagged": f'{cell_metrics["cells_low_nuclear_texture"]:,}',
            "% flagged": f"{_pct:.2f}%" if _pct is not None else "N/A",
            "Threshold": f"CCFS_DAPI ≤ {_thr}",
        })
    if "cells_blurred_gmm_2d_roi" in cell_metrics:
        _pct_gmm = cell_metrics.get("pct_blurred_gmm_2d_roi")
        if _pct_gmm is None and _n > 0:
            _pct_gmm = round(100.0 * cell_metrics["cells_blurred_gmm_2d_roi"] / _n, 2)
        _blur_rows.append({
            "Method": "GMM tile blur (relative)",
            "Cells flagged": f'{cell_metrics["cells_blurred_gmm_2d_roi"]:,}',
            "% flagged": f"{_pct_gmm:.2f}%" if _pct_gmm is not None else "N/A",
            "Threshold": "P(blur component) > 0.5",
        })
    if "ccfs_gmm_agreement_pct" in cell_metrics:
        _blur_rows.append({
            "Method": "CCFS ↔ GMM agreement",
            "Cells flagged": "",
            "% flagged": f'{cell_metrics["ccfs_gmm_agreement_pct"]:.1f}%',
            "Threshold": "(note: CCFS measures nuclear texture, not optical blur — low agreement is expected)",
        })
    if _blur_rows:
        _df_blur = pd.DataFrame(_blur_rows)
        _sty_blur = (
            _df_blur.style
            .set_table_styles(
                [
                    {"selector": "th", "props": "text-align:left; background-color:#F8FAFC;"},
                    {"selector": "td", "props": "text-align:left; vertical-align:top;"},
                ]
            )
            .hide(axis="index")
        )
        display(HTML(_sty_blur.to_html()))

    display(Markdown(
        "> **CCFS nuclear texture** uses an absolute threshold on per-cell nuclear contrast "
        "(std²/mean averaged over the nucleus mask, normalised by p99 intensity). "
        "Cells below the threshold show >50% transcript loss in calibration samples. "
        "**GMM tile blur** is a relative classification: a 2D Gaussian Mixture Model "
        "on tile-level (focus_score, Laplacian variance) identifies the lower-scoring "
        "population on each slide. Even well-focused slides show 15–30% GMM-blurred "
        "tiles because the method always splits the distribution. "
        "**Both metrics are informative but measure different things:** CCFS captures "
        "individual cells with genuinely degraded contrast; GMM captures regions that "
        "are relatively less sharp.\n>\n"
        "> ⚠ **Brain / neural tissue caveat:** CCFS is confounded by nucleus size — "
        "large neurons score lower CCFS despite high transcript counts. "
        "Interpret CCFS low-texture calls with caution for neural samples.\n>\n"
        "> ⚠ **GMM tile blur on brain / diffuse tissues:** Neuropil and diffuse "
        "morphology produce naturally lower Laplacian variance, which reduces GMM "
        "component separation and inflates the GMM-blurred tile fraction. Check the "
        "component separation (Cohen's d) in Section 6 — if WARN or FAIL, the GMM "
        "blur % is unreliable for this tissue type. Prefer the Laplacian absolute "
        "floor and spatial heatmaps for focus assessment."
    ))

    # --- Per-cluster blur breakdown ---
    _cluster_blur = cell_metrics.get("cluster_blur")
    if isinstance(_cluster_blur, dict) and _cluster_blur:
        display(Markdown("### Per-cluster blur breakdown"))
        _blur_method = cell_metrics.get("cluster_blur_method", "is_blurred_gmm_2d_roi")
        display(Markdown(
            f"Blur classification method: **{_blur_method}**. "
            "Clusters where blur rate is >2× the sample-wide average (and ≥10%) "
            "are flagged as outliers — this indicates spatially biased quality loss "
            "affecting a specific cell population."
        ))
        _cl_rows = []
        _sample_pct = cell_metrics.get(
            "pct_blurred_gmm_2d_roi",
            cell_metrics.get("pct_low_nuclear_texture", 0.0),
        )
        _outlier_thr = max(float(_sample_pct) * 2.0, 10.0) if isinstance(_sample_pct, (int, float)) else 10.0
        for cl_id in sorted(_cluster_blur.keys(), key=lambda k: int(k)):
            info = _cluster_blur[cl_id]
            is_outlier = (
                info["pct_blurred"] > _outlier_thr
                and info["n_cells"] >= 50
            )
            _cl_rows.append({
                "Cluster": f"C{cl_id}",
                "Cells": f'{info["n_cells"]:,}',
                "Blurred": f'{info["n_blurred"]:,}',
                "% blurred": f'{info["pct_blurred"]:.1f}%',
                "Median CCFS": f'{info["median_ccfs_dapi"]:.3f}',
                "Outlier": "⚠ YES" if is_outlier else "",
            })
        _df_cl = pd.DataFrame(_cl_rows)
        # Style: highlight outlier rows
        def _outlier_row_css(row):
            if "YES" in str(row.get("Outlier", "")):
                return ["background-color:#FFEDD5;"] * len(row)
            return [""] * len(row)
        _sty_cl = (
            _df_cl.style
            .set_table_styles([
                {"selector": "th", "props": "text-align:left; background-color:#F8FAFC;"},
                {"selector": "td", "props": "text-align:left; vertical-align:top;"},
            ])
            .hide(axis="index")
            .apply(_outlier_row_css, axis=1)
        )
        display(HTML(_sty_cl.to_html()))

        _outlier_clusters = cell_metrics.get("cluster_blur_outliers")
        if isinstance(_outlier_clusters, dict) and _outlier_clusters:
            _ol_names = ", ".join(f"C{k}" for k in sorted(_outlier_clusters.keys(), key=int))
            display(Markdown(
                f"> ⚠ **Cluster outlier(s) detected: {_ol_names}.** "
                "These clusters have disproportionately high blur rates, suggesting "
                "spatially concentrated quality loss that may affect downstream analysis "
                "of the corresponding cell populations. Check the spatial blur heatmap "
                "(Section 6) to see whether these clusters overlap with physically "
                "blurred regions, and consider excluding or flagging affected cells."
            ))

    display(Markdown("### Cell-level blur and focus (GMM-based)"))
    display(Markdown(
        "These figures use the **tile-level GMM blur classification** propagated to cells "
        "(`is_blurred_gmm_2d_roi`). This is the primary blur metric — it detects optical "
        "defocus using a 2D Gaussian Mixture Model on tile focus scores and Laplacian variance."
    ))

    display(Markdown("#### Cell-level focus score distribution"))
    display(Markdown(
        "Distribution of per-cell focus scores (tile focus score assigned to each cell via "
        "spatial overlap).\n\n"
        "- **Top-left:** Overall histogram of tile focus scores across all cells\n"
        "- **Top-right:** Histogram split by GMM blur classification (blue = in focus, red = blurred)\n"
        "- **Bottom-left:** Focus score density by expression cluster\n"
        "- **Bottom-right:** GMM blur probability density by cluster (threshold at 0.5)\n\n"
        "::: {.callout-tip collapse=\"true\" title=\"Interpretation\"}\n"
        "- **Clear bimodal split (top-right):** GMM separates blur from focus well — trustworthy\n"
        "- **Overlapping distributions:** GMM separation is weak — check component separation (d) in section 6\n"
        "- **Cluster-specific shifts (bottom panels):** Some clusters living in blurred regions "
        "suggests spatially biased quality loss, not biological signal\n"
        ":::"
    ))
    display(fig_html("figures/cell_focus_distribution.png"))

    display(Markdown("#### Tile blur proportions by cluster (GMM)"))
    display(Markdown(
        "For each expression cluster (k-means), shows the fraction of cells classified "
        "as blurred vs in-focus by the **2D GMM tile-level model**.\n\n"
        "- **Y-axis:** Expression clusters\n"
        "- **X-axis:** Proportion blurred (red) vs in-focus (blue)\n\n"
        "::: {.callout-tip collapse=\"true\" title=\"Interpretation\"}\n"
        "- **Uniform proportions:** All clusters have similar blur fractions — quality is spatially even\n"
        "- **Cluster-specific enrichment:** Clusters with >2x average blur rate may be confounded "
        "by imaging artefacts rather than biology\n"
        ":::"
    ))
    display(fig_html("figures/tile_blur_proportions_roi.png"))

    display(Markdown("#### GMM focus score vs transcript counts"))
    display(Markdown(
        "Scatter plot of tile-level focus score (propagated to cells) vs transcript "
        "counts per cell, coloured by GMM blur classification.\n\n"
        "::: {.callout-tip collapse=\"true\" title=\"Interpretation\"}\n"
        "- **Clear vertical separation:** Blurred cells (red) cluster at lower focus scores "
        "regardless of transcript count — blur is an imaging artefact, not biology\n"
        "- **Transcript loss in blurred cells:** If blurred cells shift left (fewer transcripts), "
        "blur is actively degrading data quality\n"
        "- **No transcript loss:** If blurred and in-focus cells have similar transcript "
        "distributions, the GMM may be over-splitting — check component separation\n"
        ":::"
    ))
    display(fig_html("figures/gmm_focus_vs_transcripts.png"))

    display(Markdown("### Nuclear texture (CCFS)"))
    display(Markdown(
        "::: {.callout-note collapse=\"true\" title=\"What is CCFS?\"}\n"
        "CCFS (Coefficient of Contrast Focus Score) measures **per-cell nuclear contrast** "
        "(local_var/local_mean over the nuclear mask). It is **not** a blur metric — it captures "
        "nuclear texture quality, which is influenced by nuclear morphology, staining intensity, "
        "and cell type. CCFS and GMM tile blur measure fundamentally different things and are "
        "expected to show low concordance.\n"
        ":::"
    ))

    display(Markdown("#### CCFS spatial map"))
    display(Markdown("Spatial map of per-cell CCFS nuclear texture values."))
    display(fig_html("figures/ccfs_spatial.png"))
    display(Markdown(
        "::: {.callout-tip collapse=\"true\" title=\"Interpretation\"}\n"
        "Coherent low-CCFS patches may indicate regional imaging issues or areas with "
        "morphologically distinct nuclei (e.g. large neurons, stromal cells).\n"
        ":::"
    ))

    display(Markdown("#### CCFS thresholded map"))
    display(Markdown("Per-cell classification using the nuclear texture threshold."))
    display(fig_html("figures/ccfs_thresholded.png"))
    display(Markdown(
        "::: {.callout-tip collapse=\"true\" title=\"Interpretation\"}\n"
        "Low-texture cell calls that cluster in specific regions may reflect tissue-specific "
        "nuclear morphology rather than imaging artefacts.\n"
        ":::"
    ))

    display(Markdown("#### Spatial comparison: CCFS vs tile focus"))
    display(Markdown(
        "Each cell coloured by the difference between its CCFS rank and its tile's focus rank.\n\n"
        "::: {.callout-tip collapse=\"true\" title=\"Interpretation\"}\n"
        "- **Uniform colour:** Both metrics agree across the slide\n"
        "- **Spatially structured disagreement:** Bands or patches often mark tile boundaries "
        "or regions where nuclear morphology differs from the surrounding tissue texture\n"
        ":::"
    ))
    display(fig_html("figures_cell_centred/spatial_comparison_nuclei_vs_roi.png"))

    display(Markdown("#### CCFS vs tile focus: correlation"))
    display(Markdown(
        "Four-panel comparison of per-cell CCFS and tile-level focus score. "
        "ρ > 0.6 indicates strong concordance; ρ < 0.3 suggests the two metrics "
        "capture different aspects of image quality."
    ))
    display(fig_html("figures/ccfs_vs_roi_comparison.png"))

    display(Markdown("#### Nuclear texture proportions by cluster"))
    display(Markdown(
        "Fraction of cells above/below the CCFS nuclear texture threshold per cluster.\n\n"
        "::: {.callout-tip collapse=\"true\" title=\"Interpretation\"}\n"
        "Clusters should have similar texture proportions. Cluster-specific bias may "
        "reflect nuclear morphology differences between cell types.\n"
        ":::"
    ))
    display(fig_html("figures/nuclear_texture_proportions.png"))

    display(Markdown("#### Nuclear texture density by cluster"))
    display(Markdown(
        "Distribution of per-cell CCFS values by cluster.\n\n"
        "::: {.callout-tip collapse=\"true\" title=\"Interpretation\"}\n"
        "CCFS captures nuclear contrast, not optical blur. Cluster separation by texture "
        "may reflect cell-type-specific nuclear morphology.\n"
        ":::"
    ))
    display(fig_html("figures/nuclear_texture_density.png"))

    display(Markdown("#### Nuclear texture vs transcript count (log scale)"))
    display(Markdown(
        "Per-cell relationship between nuclear texture quality and transcript detection.\n\n"
        "::: {.callout-tip collapse=\"true\" title=\"Interpretation\"}\n\n"
        "| Pattern | Meaning |\n"
        "|---------|--------|\n"
        "| Positive correlation | Higher texture → better detection — expected |\n"
        "| Threshold effects | Very low-texture cells typically show >50% transcript loss |\n"
        "| Weak correlation | Technical and biological factors well-separated |\n\n"
        ":::"
    ))
    display(fig_html("figures/nuclear_texture_vs_transcripts_log.png"))
```
